name: Six Seven Season
tagline: Chicken jockeys, one gorilla & way too much 6-7

cards.name: Played These Games
cards.caption: Not my first Red Light
cards.flavor: Squid Game 2: Gi-hun yells 'I've played these games before!' KYM's top meme of Jan 2025.
cards.art: Netflix still from Squid Game season 2, episode 3: Seong Gi-hun (Lee Jung-jae) shouting at the other players under pink dormitory light. The subtitle is cropped out.

cards.name: Penguin Tariffs
cards.caption: Taxed for being a penguin
cards.flavor: Apr 2, 2025: a US tariff list hit Heard Island, whose only residents are penguins.
cards.art: Photo of the real tariffed residents: king penguins standing on black volcanic sand on Heard Island, a glacier and mossy hills behind them.

cards.name: Frieren Looking Up
cards.caption: Chin? Never heard of her
cards.flavor: Nov 2025: a Redditor's wonky low-angle Frieren sketch set off a redraw craze.
cards.art: SpaceDev1's original drawing: Frieren with silver twin tails, green eyes and a red earring gazing upward, her chin a long flat wedge, on a pale blue background.

cards.name: Ashton Hall's Routine
cards.caption: Up at 3:52. Face in ice.
cards.flavor: Mar 2025: an influencer's 4 AM routine of ice dunks and banana-peel facials went global.
cards.art: Frame from Ashton Hall's Instagram Reel: shirtless and muscular, he plunges his face into a glass bowl of ice water on a white table, with the video's own '5:49 am' timestamp.

cards.name: James Doakes
cards.caption: I know. Can't prove it.
cards.flavor: Dexter's Sgt. Doakes, the one cop who knew. In 2025 his suspicious stare was everywhere.
cards.art: Still from Dexter season 1: Sgt. James Doakes (Erik King), bald with a moustache, side-eyeing someone just off-frame in a church courtyard.

cards.name: Jon Hamm Dancing
cards.caption: Dancing through the pain
cards.flavor: Late 2025: Jon Hamm's club scene from Your Friends & Neighbors became everyone's mood.
cards.art: Still from Apple TV+'s Your Friends & Neighbors: Jon Hamm, eyes closed and chin up, lost in the music under a club's blue light.

cards.name: Dubai Chocolate
cards.caption: Worth the pistachio crisis
cards.flavor: A TikTok-famous knafeh-pistachio bar. In 2025 its clones caused a pistachio shortage.
cards.art: Photo of a Dubai chocolate bar broken open on a plate, showing its green pistachio and crispy kataifi filling.

cards.name: 100 Men vs 1 Gorilla
cards.caption: We only gotta win once
cards.flavor: Apr 2025: who wins, 100 unarmed men or one silverback? The internet still can't agree.
cards.art: The painted-style AI image from the debate (left half of KYM's header): a silverback gorilla on a grassy plain facing a long column of shirtless men under a cloudy sky.

cards.name: Montoya Por Favor
cards.caption: Heartbreak speedrun
cards.flavor: Feb 2025, Spanish reality TV: Montoya sprints off down a beach as the host begs him back.
cards.art: Telecinco still from La Isla de las Tentaciones: José Carlos Montoya in an open white shirt and black shorts, springing up from the night-time bonfire a moment before his sprint.

cards.name: Jet2 Holiday
cards.caption: Darling, hold my hand
cards.flavor: Jet2's chirpy ad voice plus Jess Glynne's 'Hold My Hand' scored every disaster of 2025.
cards.art: Photo of a Jet2holidays Boeing 737-800 taxiing at Tenerife South, the red 'Jet2holidays' logo on its white fuselage and a volcanic hill behind.

cards.name: Chicken Jockey
cards.caption: CHICKEN JOCKEY!!!
cards.flavor: A Minecraft Movie, Apr 2025: Jack Black yells it and cinemas erupt in popcorn and chaos.
cards.art: Film still: the grinning CGI baby zombie in a teal shirt riding a fluffy, blocky white chicken into the boxing ring.

cards.caption: Word of the Year, somehow
cards.flavor: Skrilla's 'Doot Doot (6 7)' met LaMelo Ball edits, then became Dictionary.com's 2025 WOTY.
cards.art: Photo of rapper Skrilla grinning with gold grills (the left half of KYM's header, cropped below its 'Six Seven' text and away from the 67 Kid on the right).
